STAGE 1 - goal: establish whether the r13 pathway is connected and where the behaviour statistic comes from.
Read: manifests/BRad-RQ_r13.txt (18 files: model/{__init__,behaviour_radius,frechet_poincare,layers,model,utils}.py, 8 tests, train_rqvae.py), findings/BRad-RQ_r13.json (r1: model/model.py absent, get_indices absent), train_rqvae.py (639 lines), model/model.py (117), model/layers.py (386), model/behaviour_radius.py (105), model/__init__.py.
Observed: model/model.py now exists with scale_by_radius (no no_grad), set_radii (non-persistent buffer), forward(radius=) and get_indices that applies table[ids]. train_rqvae.py:473 passes radius=radii[item_ids]; :445-447 builds radii from train.parquet only; :582 export calls get_indices with item_ids=arange. layers.py:156-166 radial branch -> radial_cost -> behaviour_radius.assignment_score (Poincare kernel). r1 findings appear fixed in-process.
Open: read tests (permission denied), confirm whether the radial branch can be inert (row-scaling of the Poincare kernel), check rank domain N vs training items, check non-persistent radius_table consequence for checkpoint re-export.
